top_signals.title: World Bank’s Mishra Pushes Back on India GDP Doubts
top_signals.summary: A range of high-frequency indicators show India’s economy is gaining momentum, said World Bank Executive Director Neelkanth Mishra, pushing back against skepticism over whether strong headline growth reflects conditions on the ground.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
